note: timing-v030-1120 (Rodney 2026-11-20 "timing test for our release today ... baseline first ... then comparisons"; README numbers Baseline vs v0.3.1 (hf031), memory public-measurements-baseline-vs-latest). Arm off = README Baseline (community stack without our mods: ourMods false, v027-baseline-true spec), arm on = v0.3.0 Steam release (rc-1119b set, release ini). Both on Bin state apex = latest Apex release 4.0.11 manual-install zip + RTX Remix bridge, S3SS, S3PP, MonoPatcher, ts3agent rc-1119b (harness only). Separate loads, 10 min each, seed 12345, story progression off, noise check on, light tools only (noSamplers; frames + prof-stages). Per world ABBA (off, on, on, off): BP, IP, SV = 12 jobs + declared smoke (on arm BP) ~3.1 h. Rewind off: the off arm has no ts3native, so it cannot rewind, and both arms must start the same way. Why not reuse rebaseline-1116c: Apex 4.0.1 (now 4.0.11), and it is the shipped stack (ON bundle), not the Baseline without our mods. Run ONLY through probe-out/queue/chain-timing-v030-1120.sh (Bin state apex, quiet checks, one queue.ts --only call per job). Read: node tools/harness/arm-ms.ts timing-v030-1120 per world (off vs on), hitch-ab.ts --pool, run-verdict.ts timing-v030-1120.
